name: Wicflow, 'AI at work' (Direction C: Spiced), 37.5 s VO film
thesis: Wicflow's AI does the real work that moves a business forward. The film shows it on one bright isometric model of the viewer's business, in Wicflow's white, ink and three service tints: the site's blue 'AI at work' dot finds the right company, writes to Anna, follows up, keeps the CRM updated inside the team's own tools, starts as one pilot, scales across the business, and at the end becomes the business's growth and then the W mark.
allowed_patterns: The isometric town as an illustration of the viewer's business: YOUR BUSINESS as one ink block, three rounded district plates in the site's own service tints (sales = blue, marketing = sand, everyday work = sage), unnamed white blocks as companies on the sales plate, a screen panel with a play triangle (marketing / AI video), a stack of sheets and a calendar tile (everyday tasks)
The site's live 'AI at work' dot (#1769C2 with its 12% halo) as the AI doing the work: its blue paths, its scan lens, and the film's only full-bleed AI-blue field (P21)

A status chip top left rebuilt from the site's hero header ('AI at work' · wicflow.com), flipping only through the site's own demo states: Found a company that fits · 09:02, Wrote the first message · 09:03, Ready for a follow-up · Check in, Connected to your existing workflows, Meeting booked · Thursday 10:00, in your calendar · 11:41

The site's illustrative demo, word for word: Building firm · 40 staff · Tampere; 'Hi Anna, I saw you're hiring two salespeople…'; your team's approval before sending (shown as an ink 'Approved' pill); 'Anna replied · 11:40 · Sounds useful. Thursday at 10?'; Meetings booked this week 7 → 8 (illustrative, as the site shows it)
The site's illustrative sales view statuses on the demo company: New contact → Added to your CRM, next step 'Review the fit'
The site's workflow strip 'Reach out → Follow up → Update your CRM' and the 15 tool logos in the site's own 5×3 tile order and tile style (front-facing, never skewed)
One generic assistant chat bubble ('How can I help?') as the foil for 'didn't just assist'. It is not presented as Wicflow's product
A pilot block with a black site-button pill 'Pilot', its copies spread across the plates as 'scale' (never counted, no number shown)
Text-free reply bubbles as 'more conversations' (only Anna's has words) that flip into ink 'Meeting booked' calendar badges (the site's icon, never counted)
Kinetic type marks, one per phrase: strike (assist, manual), sweep, underline, hand-drawn ring (one), slot rolls. Captions ≤6 words a line, key word in AI blue
A7 punchy title pop used once, on the giant white 'AI' over the AI-blue field
The business block growing three floors as 'real business growth' (no chart, no figures)
The W mark revealed out of the business block's roof; the site's hero line 'An AI partner that runs your sales and marketing.' and its CTA pill 'AI analysis'
Bright by default (client palette and Karl's standing rule): white paper ground throughout, no dark background
world: WHAT IT MODELS: the viewer's own business as a small isometric town on white paper, the domain of the film (as Cartesian models a store and ClearScaler a market). At the centre is YOUR BUSINESS: one ink block, 2.5×2.5 units, roof rhombus ~280 px wide, ~90 px tall. Around it are three rounded district plates, the site's radius-24 service panels laid flat in isometric as 14 px slabs, one for each area the VO names. SALES (blue tint, 5×5 u, ~560×280 px, centre ≈(1500,690), right-front) holds nine white company blocks in a 3×3 grid, 1×1 u, heights 0.6–1.2 u: the market and its prospects. MARKETING (sand tint, 4×4 u, centre ≈(880,330), back-left) holds an upright white screen panel 160×110 with an AI-blue play triangle (the site's AI video) and two flat post cards. EVERYDAY WORK (sage tint, 4×4 u, centre ≈(1500,300), right-back) holds a stack of four sheets and a calendar tile, standing for the repeated tasks. Streets between the plates are travelled by the AI dot, and its paths become 'the system'. Later states of the same stage: a white pilot block that rises in front of your business; its copies on every plate and on new plates in the three tints at the frame edges (scale); and your block growing floors. Nothing is built for one beat and thrown away: the stack, the building firm and your roof each come back. PROJECTION (code, no 3D engine): 2:1 dimetric, screenX = ox + (gx−gy)·k, screenY = oy + (gx+gy)·k/2 − gz·k, with k = 56 px per unit at town scale. Faces are SVG polygons in painter's order (back-to-front by gx+gy). Logos, cards, tags and type are always front-facing, never skewed. LOOK, HEX ROLES: ground paper #FFFFFF (never dark); paper-2 #F7F7F9 for soft ground shadows under plates; neutral blocks have top #FFFFFF, left face #F4F4F7 (paper-3), right face #D6D6D9 at 55% (≈#E8E8EA), and 1.5 px #D6D6D9 edges. Blocks standing on a plate take that plate's tint steps for their sides: blue #F1F5FB/#E6EDF7/#DFE7F3, sand #F8F4EC/#F0E9DC/#EAE1D1, sage #F1F6F1/#E5EEE6/#DDE8DE. Plates have top tint[0], slab edge tint[2] and a hairline in tint[2]. YOUR BUSINESS has top #17171B (ink), sides #0A0A0D (ink-strong) and #606069 hairline edges, the site's black-button language. AI blue #1769C2 is used only for the AI: the dot (22 px core, halo ring 46 px #1769C21F), paths (5 px, round caps, 35% opacity when idle, 100% when live), caption key words and marks, and the one full-bleed field. Muted #606069 is for secondary text. Cards, the chip and tags are #FFFFFF, radius 24 (cards) or 999 (pills), hairline #0000001F, shadow 0 24 60 #17171B14 (the site's soft float). Pills are ink: bg #0A0A0D, text #EEEEF1. Display type is Space Grotesk 600 at −0.045em (captions, numbers, card titles); Manrope 400/700 is for UI labels. While a full tint field is up, plates switch to white tops so the town stays readable. COMPOSITION: town centred around (1180,520), keeping clear the chip zone top left (x 110–760, y 70–270) and the caption zone bottom left (x 120–1100, y 790–1010). Cards unfold into the left-centre (x 360–1300, y 300–620) or right (x 880–1800) over the town, which dims to 40–45%. Only one card is ever open at a time.
thread_object:
THE AI-AT-WORK DOT: #1769C2, 22 px with its 12% halo, the live dot from Wicflow's own hero card, the site's 'colour of the AI working'. It carries the whole film:
- P1: it falls onto the roof of your business on 'AI'.
- P2: it waits as the avatar in an assistant chat bubble ('just assist').
- P3: the bubble collapses back into it. It runs ahead and draws the blue road your business launches forward on.
- P4: it lives in the chip from 'Wicflow'.
- P6–P8: it whips plate to plate, and each arrival blooms that area's tint across the frame.
- P9: it opens into the scan lens that finds the building firm.
- P10–P12: the message card collapses into it and it is sent; a second dot follows up by itself; it carries the CRM update home.
- P13: its trails close into the loop that connects everything.
- P15: it hops onto the one pilot block.
- P17: it switches on in every copy.
- P21: on 'AI' it irises out into the film's only full-bleed AI-blue field.
- P22: the field folds back into the roof of your business, which grows three floors with the blue roof on top.
- P23: the roof lifts off, turns ink and becomes the diamond at the heart of the W mark, which grows out of it.
PAYOFF: the colour of AI at work becomes the roof of your growth, and the roof of your growth becomes the Wicflow mark. A second, smaller thread is YOUR BUSINESS block: it moves forward (P3), everything unfolds from it and folds back into it (P10–P14), everything gathers into it (P21), it grows (P22) and it gives the mark (P23).
colour_plan:
Colour changes with the story, always through a mask that grows out of an object and never as a crossfade. Soft fields are radial like the site's panels (tint[0] at the object → tint[2] at the edges). Order:
1. 0.00–7.85 WHITE paper #FFFFFF. Ink block, AI-blue dot and paths, the three plates in their tints from 5.88.
2. 7.85 BLUE TINT field (#F1F5FB → #DFE7F3) irises out of the SALES plate at the dot's arrival (whipOut 12f).
3. 8.45 SAND field (#F8F4EC → #EAE1D1) irises out of the MARKETING screen panel over the blue.
4. 9.35 SAGE field (#F1F6F1 → #DDE8DE) irises out of the EVERYDAY sheet stack. These three are the rhythmic burst of the film, one per spoken area; the caption's slot word rolls on the same frames.
5. 10.50–10.77 the sage field DRAINS back into the sheet stack it came from (reverse iris on whipIn) while the dot whips to the sales plate. White paper returns for the work.
6. 10.77–18.45 WHITE. Blue lives only in the dot, paths, tags, key words and sweeps. Cards are white over the town dimmed to 45%.
7. 18.45 SAGE field irises out of the junction at your block where the loop closes ('connects'). It is the site's connected-tools panel colour, and the 15 white tool tiles sit on it.
8. 21.82 a WHITE wash grows out of the PILOT block over the sage (focus on 'one'), then the B16 zoom-through.
9. 22.27–31.60 WHITE (pilot, measure, scale, results). The copies' new plates carry the three tints as a quiet callback. A white wash covers the left of the town under the big result type.
10. 31.60 FULL-BLEED AI BLUE #1769C2 irises out of the AI dot on your roof. This is the only saturated full field in the film, on 'AI'; the caption and the giant 'AI' are white on it.
11. 32.16 the blue field CONTRACTS into your roof (iris closing, MOVE 12f). White returns and the roof stays AI blue.
12. 34.04 the roof turns from AI blue to ink #0A0A0D as it lifts into the W mark.
13. 35.00–37.50 WHITE end card: ink mark, ink wordmark, muted line, black pill.
Never dark. The only near-black areas are the business block, pills and the mark, all small.
motion_identity:
PERSONALITY: an energetic premium launch film. Crisp, decisive, optimistic, never jittery. The energy comes from content (things rise, whip, flip, bloom); the camera only breathes. ENERGY CURVE (0–10):
- 0–2.7 hook build 4→5: small, fast arrivals.
- 2.7–4.9 punch 6: strike, path, launch forward.
- 4.9–5.6 breath 4.
- 5.6–7.8 build 6: the town rises.
- 7.8–10.4 burst 8: three dot whips, three colour fields.
- 10.4–17.6 flow 6–7: steady travelling work, one card at a time.
- 17.6–18.1 inhale 5.
- 18.1–21.1 impact/lift 9: loop closes, sage bloom, tool cascade.
- 21.1–22.6 focus 4, then the zoom-through spike 7.
- 22.6–23.4 calm 3: the pilot alone.
- 23.4–25.9 build 5→7: tick, then one becomes many.
- 25.9–26.4 inhale 5.
- 26.4–30.3 peak 9: three type hits.
- 30.3–31.5 gather 6.
- 31.6 the single biggest impact 10: AI-blue flood.
- 32.2–34.9 resolve 6→4: growth steps, lock.
- 35.0–37.5 calm 2: end card.
SIGNATURE CURVE: ARRIVE cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1), expo-out, for every arrival. DEPART (0.55,0,0.9,0.4) for exits, at 70% of the entrance time. Whips use EASE.whipIn (0.9,0,1,1) into the cut and EASE.whipOut (0,0,0.1,1) out of it, with the shape change on the fastest frame and motion blur on the 4 fastest frames. Parts follow on EASE.lead/EASE.follow (B9, followers 3f behind, never more than 6f).
DURATION PALETTE (30 fps):
- pop: 5f in, settling by 10–12f
- quick: 8f
- standard: 12f
- deliberate: 20f
- big content move: 30f
- whip halves: 7–10f
- zoom-through: 10f + 10f
- word cascade: 7f a word, on the spoken word times
- caption exit: 8f
ENTRANCE PATTERN: things rise out of the ground (blocks and plates extrude from height 0); cards and tags unfold out of the block they belong to on a stem and fold back into it; colour fields iris out of the object that owns them; type builds word by word on the force-aligned words (A5: 0.4em rise). Nothing fades up from nowhere and nothing scales from zero.
SPEED GRAPHS USED:
- A1: dot whips P6–P9, card→dot send P11
- A2: chip states, caption slot rolls, CRM pill, 7→8, tag roll
- A5: captions
- A6: Anna message type-on
- A7: 'AI', once
- B2: big content moves (scale-out, gather-in, roof lift)
- B4: lens
- B5: small pops
- B6: launch, hop, follow-up, flood wind-up
- B7: strikes, stack collapse
- B9: unfolds
- B11: paths, loop
- B13: strip steps, growth floors
- B15: breath
- B16: once, P15
- B17: sweeps, scan
OVERSHOOT is allowed only on small pops, one ≈5–10% overshoot (B5): the dot landing, the chat bubble, the tags, the 15 tool tiles (5%), the 'Approved' and 'Pilot' pills, Anna's bubble, the check and the badges. The one A7 elastic is on the giant 'AI'. Blocks, plates, cards, fields, type lines and the mark never overshoot or bounce. CAMERA: one slow breath for the whole film (B15: ≤10 px drift, 4 s period, plus scale 1.00→1.02 per act, always under 25 px/s and 5%/s). No pans, zooms or releases on transitions; the one zoom-through is the pilot block scaling. BUSY RULE: one lead motion at a time, with at most one follower group and one small chip change. Never two cards open, and no more than about 4 separate motions on screen.
transition_family: OUT OF AN OBJECT AND BACK INTO IT (masks and unfolds). Colour fields iris out of the plate, stack, junction, pilot or dot that owns them, and drain back into it (sage → stack at 10.5, AI blue → roof at 32.16). Every card (message, CRM, tools, measure) unfolds out of the block it belongs to on a stem and folds back into the same block. No crossfade between layouts anywhere.

OBJECT BECOMES THE NEXT THING (match transformation and layout transformation). Each one in order: the assistant bubble collapses into the AI dot (P3); the dot's path becomes the road the business moves on (P3); the dot opens into the scan lens (P9); the message card becomes the sent dot (P11); the dot's trails close into the loop (P13); the pilot shrinks back into the town and is copied outward to many (P17); reply bubbles flip into booking badges (P20); everything gathers into your block (P21); the AI-blue field folds into the roof (P22); the roof becomes the heart of the W mark (P23).

SPEED-MATCHED WHIPS THROUGH CUTS (Karl's Training.aep). A1 dot whips between districts with the colour field blooming on the fastest frame (P6, P7, P8, back at P9). A1 card-to-dot send along the blue line (P11, cut at 14.45). A2 drop-throughs in one spot for the chip states, the caption slot word (sales → marketing → everyday work), the work-line rolls (P9–P12), the CRM pill, the tag 'Your team' → 'Your business' and the counter 7 → 8. ONE B16 zoom-through: the pilot block itself scales ×4 into the cut on 'focused' (22.27) and the pilot scene grows from 25% (P15).

end_card:
35.00–37.50, the calmest moment of the film, on white #FFFFFF. Only the mark and the words arrive; nothing flies, orbits or travels.
- 35.00: the W mark (ink #0A0A0D, traced SVG, ~230 px wide), complete from P23, holds. 'wicflow.com' (Space Grotesk 600, 92 px, −0.045em, ink) slides out from behind the mark to the right through a mask at the mark's edge (ARRIVE 14f). The lockup re-centres as one unit (B1, 12f) to x 960, y 430, as in the site header.
- 35.55: the site's hero line builds word by word below, centred (Space Grotesk 600, 44 px, muted #606069, 0.06 s a word, 0.3em rise): 'An AI partner that runs / your sales and marketing.'
- 36.25: the site's CTA, a black pill 'AI analysis' (#0A0A0D, text #EEEEF1, Manrope 700 30 px, 300×84, radius 999), rises 24 px with a fade (ARRIVE 12f) at y ≈780.
- Throughout: one slow push on the whole card (content scale 1.00→1.02 over 2.5 s, B3). No dot, no lines, no pulse on the button.
Sound: the tonic pad rings out with one soft bell or pluck on 35.0, reaching silence by 37.5.
music:
TEMPO AND FEEL: 118–122 BPM, 4/4, bright optimistic electronic pop with a light future-bass colour. Plucked synth arps, warm side-chained pads, claps and finger snaps, a tight punchy kick, a round sub. No vocals or vocal chops, because the VO owns the mids: carve 1–4 kHz under the voice and duck the music 6–8 dB while she speaks. Audition the candidates already in films/wicflow/sound/music (find-future-bass, find-upbeat, find-technology, find-positive) and fit with scripts/music_fit.py so a downbeat or hit lands at 5.55, 18.45, 26.38 and 31.60. Otherwise compose with scripts/music_make.py.
SECTIONS:
- INTRO 0.0–5.5: filtered pluck arp and soft pulse, no kick; the filter opens slowly, a 2-beat snare build from 4.0, a reverse swell into 'Wicflow' 5.59.
- A 5.55–10.4: the beat enters (kick, claps, bright plucks). The three dot whips at 7.85 / 8.45 / 9.35 sit on beats with pluck accents; fill 10.0–10.4.
- A2 10.4–17.6: FLOW. 16th hats, pads ducked under the demo; 17.0–18.0 a one-bar riser and snare roll.
- LIFT 18.0–21.3: full band, bass up an octave, wider pads, crash on the loop closure 18.45 ('connects'); low-pass begins closing at 20.8.
- BREAK 21.3–23.4: kick out, low-pass to about 600 Hz, one sustained chord. The zoom-through whoosh peaks on the cut at 22.27 inside this space.
- BUILD 23.4–26.3: half-time kick from 23.4, four-on-the-floor from 24.6, riser 24.6–26.3.
- PEAK 26.38–30.4: the hardest bar, with stabs on 'Less' 26.38, 'more' 27.68 and 'more' 29.13.
- GATHER 30.4–31.2: rhythm thins, pull-back swell.
- DROPOUT 31.20–31.60: one beat of near-silence under the VO.
- HIT 31.60: the film's biggest impact, reverse cymbal into it, for the AI-blue flood.
- RESOLVE 32.2–35.0: three rising stabs on the floors (32.52 / 33.02 / 33.44), cadence to the tonic at 34.9.
- OUTRO 35.0–37.5: tonic pad and one bell or pluck on the logo, natural ring-out to silence by 37.5.
MIX: integrated about −14 LUFS, VO on top. SFX are sparse and only on the lead moves listed per phrase (one combined sound for any cascade), from sound/lib/sfx (pop, whoosh/swipe, tap, ticker, impact, riser, success/chime, appear-rise), never a sound on every movement.
risks: BUSY: the hot spots are P9 (lens + blocks + tag + chip), P14 (15-tile cascade), P17 (pilot shrink + copies rising + dots), P19 (Anna + bubble wave) and P21 (gather-in of ~30 objects). Keep one lead at a time, followers on B9 within 6f, chip changes always secondary and at a different moment from the lead. Run busy_check.py / motion_probe.py on every build and take things away where the eye can't tell what to watch.

COLOUR BURST P6–P8: three full-bleed tint irises in 1.5 s could strobe or read as a showreel. Keep the pale tint steps only (never AI blue), let each field grow over the previous one (never back to white in between), switch plates to white tops while a field is up, and check blue key words for contrast on the tints (#1769C2 on #DFE7F3 at 72 px).

K.B SPIKE LESSON: the whips, the zoom-through, the scale-out and the gather-in are big content moves that could read as camera moves. Only elements move (the dot, a card, the pilot block, copies), the town never pans, every whip builds speed into its cut, and nothing starts at full speed on something already visible. Measure every transition with motion_probe.py and keep the breath under 25 px/s and 5%/s.

CARD-FILM DRIFT (tell: UI cards): message, CRM, tools and measure cards plus Anna's bubble add up to five panels. Each unfolds out of a world object and folds back, never two at once, always over the dimmed town. If it starts to feel like a deck of cards, cut the CRM card to the pill alone, standing on your block.

READABILITY: 1080p text minimums are 34 px in bubbles and cards, 26 px in pills, and 60 px logos in tiles (names at 20 px may be too small; drop the names before shrinking the logos). The town's small blocks at k = 56 must stay legible after the 0.75 rescale; the building firm and the sheet stack must be findable again in P18–P19.

W MARK TRANSITION: the traced SVG is one even-odd compound path, so the roof diamond must be matched to the crossing point at the mark's centre (≈52.7%, 56.6% of its bounding box). Fallback if the shape match looks wrong: a plain circular iris reveal of the mark from the roof point, without the un-squash. Check the trace against wicflow-mark.png before delivery (missing.md).

A7 ON 'AI': an elastic, tilted 340 px word risks looking cheap in a premium film. Fallback: an ARRIVE 100 px rise with no tilt and no elastic. Also check the 1-beat music dropout before 31.60 doesn't leave the voice sounding exposed.

DENSE HOOK: P3 packs strike, bubble collapse, path, tag roll and launch into 2.2 s. Check at 2-frame steps that only one of them leads at a time. If not, drop the tag roll and keep 'Your business' as a static label.

CLAIMS: pairing the demo company with the sales-view statuses ('Building firm · Tampere · Added to your CRM') and with 'To Anna' is a light synthesis of two illustrative site demos, so name it in thesis.md. The 7 → 8 counter (P16) comes before Anna's reply (P19) in film order: both are illustrative, so no ordering claim is made. The 'How can I help?' bubble is generic assistant copy used as the foil, not presented as Wicflow. No other numbers or customers appear; 30+/10+/5 are deliberately unused.

TEXT COLLISIONS: the caption slot rolls (P6–P8), work-line rolls (P9–P12) and stacked lists (P15–P17, P18–P20) must never overlap during their A2 changes. Use a shared mask per slot and check every type change frame by frame.

SCOPE FOR ONE DEVELOPER: the isometric painter's order with plates, blocks, copies and a growing block, plus the 15 logo assets (mixed svg/png), blur on whips and five card layouts, is a lot. Build the stage as data (grid positions plus heights) and one projection function, reuse kinetic.tsx (whip, zoomThrough, Roll, Typed, Iris, stepper, popElastic, Flip), and render a phrase_check.py sheet on the first draft so every phrase shows a new visual and no gap exceeds 2.5 s.
